text: nice getting there. lets do that next slice now then
resolution: Migrated the complete active Color Studio input plane behind the application CommandAuthority. Material/variant/seed/quality/slot/view/current-color choices now publish report-only outcomes; settled color selection is idempotent and never consumes undo. Slot fill/reset and tray add/library load are exact reversible workspace actions with a dedicated session-scoped Studio journal, Ctrl-Z/Ctrl-Y correlation, and typed material.edit/palette.edit reports carrying forward/inverse transactions. Material cards, Color Studio, and the shared model/facade paint bucket now invoke the same handlers with source metadata. Added pure transaction, headless command, malformed/no-op, exact undo/redo, and typed-event coverage. ReleaseFast editor ship passes.
